retrieval_policy: Public-domain classical texts only, fetched from zh.wikisource.org at pinned revision ids with a descriptive User-Agent and >=2 s between requests. No face images or personal data are fetched or transferred.
license_note: Original classical texts are public domain (authors died more than 100 years ago). Wikisource transcription/punctuation layer is CC BY-SA 4.0; attribution and source URL are kept on every passage.

literature.title: 神相全編
literature.text_witness: 欽定古今圖書集成 博物彙編 藝術典 相術部彙考1-14 (神相全編一~十四), all14volumes pinned from Wikisource
literature.priority_reason: Named in the requirements specification; the only witness here with complete per-type entries for brow/eye/nose/ear/mouth; already the basis of data/interpretation_catalog_v1.json.
literature.notes: The 古今圖書集成 reproduction of 神相全編 embeds pieces it attributes to other authors (e.g. 許負, 袁柳莊, 達摩). Such attributions are recorded per passage in source.attributed_to; they are attributions printed in the compilation, not independent witnesses of those books.
literature.punctuation_note: Wikisource banner on these pages (snapshot 2026-10-14): the original has no punctuation; punctuation was created by the AI program 古詩文斷句 v2.1 and improved by Wikisource users (CC BY-SA 4.0). Passage boundaries and quoted punctuation therefore follow a machine-punctuated transcription; annotators flagged doubtful breaks in commentary.

literature.title: 許負相法

literature.priority_reason: Named in the requirements specification; standalone text available.
literature.notes: All16chapters and preface preserved in source archive. Chapters9-16 concern body, movement or voice and are not face-service morphology targets.
literature.punctuation_note: Punctuated Wikisource transcription (夷門廣牘 text); no punctuation provenance banner on the snapshotted pages.

literature.title: 太清神鑑
literature.text_witness: Wikisource 太清神鑑 (四庫全書本), 6 卷
literature.priority_reason: Named in the requirements specification (as 太淸神鑑); 四庫全書 edition. The 四庫 提要 itself states the attribution to 王朴 is spurious and the text was reassembled from 永樂大典 fragments.
literature.notes: Unpunctuated 四庫 text; some characters are rendered on Wikisource as images whose alt text is kept.
literature.punctuation_note: 四庫全書 text is unpunctuated on Wikisource; passages quote it without added punctuation.

literature.title: 柳莊相法
literature.text_witness: 文明書局 (上海) 1925 printing, 秦慎安 collation, National Library of China scans on Wikimedia Commons: NLC511-03030560-63880 (上) + NLC511-03030559-70286 (下) as primary witness, NLC416-13jh001257-42702 as independent second copy
literature.priority_reason: Named in the requirements specification. Lowest priority because its text comes from an AI visual transcription of image-only scans, not a proofread transcription; conflicts resolve toward the Wikisource-proofread witnesses.
literature.notes: The Commons PDFs have no text layer and no Wikisource Index/Page transcription exists (checked 2026-10-14). Full page-level transcriptions of all pages are preserved in transcriptions/. A passage can only be service-eligible if its transcribed text also occurs in the independently transcribed second copy.
literature.punctuation_note: The printing marks sentence breaks with side circles; transcriptions omit them, so quoted originals are unpunctuated except printed ○ and 〈〉 notes.

evidence: zh.wikisource.org search (intitle:柳莊相法, 柳莊相法) on 2026-10-14 returned no page for this book.
ctext.org answered scripted requests on 2026-10-14 with a bot-protection page; nothing was retrieved.
The 古今圖書集成 神相全編 volumes 8-9 (藝術典 卷638-639) print pieces headed 袁柳莊識人賦, 袁柳莊人象賦 and 袁柳莊雜論; these are attributed pieces inside 神相全編, not the book 柳莊相法.

2026-10-14 second dispatch: Commons NLC PDFs (3 files) downloaded; no text layer, no Wikisource transcription; transcribed page by page by AI visual reading and cross-checked between two physical copies.
Pieces headed 麻衣金鎖賦 and 麻衣雜論 appear inside the 古今圖書集成 神相全編 (卷637, 卷639).
